overloads.semanticRole: The SET WINDOW RECT command changes the global coordinates of the window whose reference number is passed in window .

interactionNotes.note: By default, executing this command moves the designated window to the foreground. Passing '*' as the last parameter disables that: the window's original level (z-order) is left unchanged.

constraints: If window does not designate an existing window, the command does nothing.

Coordinates are relative to the top-left corner of the application window's contents area (Windows MDI mode) or to the main screen (macOS and Windows SDI mode), and describe the window's contents area (excluding title bar/borders); using Screen width/Screen height to double-check values is recommended since the command lets you move a window beyond the main window's or screen's limits.
Does not move or resize the form objects contained in the window regardless of their resizing properties; use RESIZE FORM WINDOW to also account for object resizing properties.
